question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who collects coins
solution:
The correct answer is **'Numismatist'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Fatalist - **a person who advances the idea that all events are naturally predetermined or subject to fate
 
• **Philatelist - **one who collects or studies stamps.
 
• **Numismatist - **one who collects or studies coins, tokens, paper money, and sometimes related objects (such as medals)
 
• **Anthropologist - **someone who scientifically studies humans and their customs, beliefs, and relationships.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that **numismatist **is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 

 

Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer.
